summary: Dependency resolved from an unpinned GitHub source
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. On `npm install`, this resolves to the current HEAD of that GitHub repository and installs whatever tarball it produces, executing any lifecycle scripts it contains. Because the source is a mutable git reference rather than a pinned registry version with an integrity hash, the content installed on the host can change at any time without a corresponding publish of @wanzforme/bails, and whoever controls the referenced GitHub account controls the code that runs on the installer's machine. The ping/GET pattern surfaced in lib/Utils/generics.js is ordinary HTTP/network client code and is not by itself an attack indicator; the supply-chain exposure here comes from the manifest's off-registry, unpinned dependency source.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
